description: Verified on-chain whale trades ($10K+ DEX swaps) in the last 24h, combined per coin: buys vs sells in USD, net flow, number of wallets, plus the most active whale wallets. Also big Hyperliquid futures orders per coin (longs vs shorts opened, latest orders with wallet and position after) — leveraged bets, reported separately from the DEX buys and sells. Optionally narrow to one coin by ticker or contract address.
